authorship.method: Original analytic phase poses, measured two-bone IK, actual skinned sole/body probes and independent palmar/finger morph control. No motion capture.

ball.meaning: Presentation centre, orientation and visibility only. A game must decide ownership, physics, collisions and scoring independently.
ball.trajectory: Each dribble uses a calibrated short hand-push/braking interval and9.81m/s² free flight, with exact upper receive and floor-bounce times. Fast crossovers use greater hand force; a slow protective dribble can dwell briefly at the top. Shot/finish trajectories use9.81m/s² after release and a0.58 first-bounce restitution. This authored presentation trajectory is not a rigid-body collision simulation.

clips.label: החזקת כדור
clips.notes: Two hands on the ball; slow breathing. No bounce. The finger pads, thumb opposition and palmar markers are separate from gameplay ownership.

clips.label: כדרור ימין
clips.notes: Right-hand push, release, concave-down fall, floor bounce and upper receive; the left hand protects space.

clips.label: כדרור שמאל
clips.notes: Mirrored hand ownership, with independently authored timing and the right hand protecting space.

clips.label: כדרור כוח והגנה
clips.notes: Lower, wider protected bounce on the right side; lowered pelvis and shielding off arm.

clips.label: כדרור צולב
clips.notes: Two bounces per cycle, crossing in front of the body, right to left and back.

clips.label: כדרור בין הרגליים
clips.notes: Two bounces per cycle, right-front to left-rear through the widened leg gap, then return. Gather waits for the front right-hand catch.

clips.label: קליעה מהמקום
clips.notes: Standing shot. Ball rises in front of the face to the shooting shoulder; guide releases before the shooting hand, then high wrist follow-through.

clips.label: קליעה בקפיצה
clips.notes: Jump shot with load, takeoff, high release, held follow-through and controlled landing.

clips.label: קליעה בנסיגה באוויר
clips.notes: Backward pelvis travel while airborne; the released ball continues from its release anchor rather than inheriting subsequent body motion.

clips.label: צעד לאחור וקליעה
clips.notes: Separate retreat foot placements precede the loaded shot. No gameplay foul, shot result or score is implied.

clips.label: לייאפ
clips.notes: Asymmetric approach, opposite knee lift, palmar support under the ball and a high one-hand release.

clips.label: דאנק ביד אחת
clips.notes: One-hand finish, opposite arm balancing, role-measured jump height and a downward free ball after release.

clips.label: דאנק בשתי ידיים
clips.notes: Symmetrical two-hand grip above the head, downward finish and bent-leg landing.

clips.label: דאנק אחורי
clips.notes: Whole-body half-turn through Hips, hands and feet turning together, two-hand backward finish; Chest remains within a small relative twist.

clips.label: רב-צעד ואיסוף
clips.notes: First lateral plant and weight transfer, opposite second plant, ball gathered across the torso and a small final lift.

clips.label: ריצה
clips.notes: In-place running gait, reciprocal bent elbows, shoulder/pelvis counter-rotation, forward lean, relaxed fists and heel/toe roll. Gameplay must supply forward travel.

clips.label: האטה ובלימה
clips.notes: Lead foot plants ahead of the pelvis; knees compress and the trunk brakes before the trailing step settles.

clips.label: הגנה בצעדי צד
clips.notes: Lead foot steps, plants, then the trailing foot catches up; supported foot X/Z remains stationary within each plant window.

clips.label: חטיפה
clips.notes: Right shoulder and trunk commit forward into a low lateral hand sweep, then recover. No hit, possession change or collision is implied.

clips.label: חסימה
clips.notes: Loaded two-foot jump, extended right reach and a controlled return. No blocked-shot result is inferred.

clips.label: ריבאונד ואחיזה
clips.notes: Hands receive above the head and draw the ball to the chest while landing.

clips.label: צעדים ללא כדור
clips.notes: In-place walking gait with a longer stance phase and lower swing clearance. Gameplay must supply forward travel.

clips.label: עבודת רגליים ללא כדור
clips.notes: Weight over the left forefoot; the right foot follows a visible arc. The left toe marker, rather than the ankle, is the pivot anchor.

clips.label: חגיגה
clips.notes: One raised clenched fist, asymmetric free arm and a small weight bounce; no real-person celebration or likeness.

clips.label: נפילה והתאוששות
clips.notes: Side brace and ground contact, roll into a kneeling lunge, then a hand-assisted rise into a split stance. A presentation fall, not a safety demonstration.

clips.label: סימון שופט
clips.notes: An open right-hand signal with a relaxed, partly curled free hand.

transitions.dribbleToHold: Continue the bounce to its upper receive. Between-legs completes to the front-hand catch. Preserve the displayed pose and actual post-constraint ball velocity; interpolate hand frames on shortest quaternion arcs, route the rear hand around the body, solve contact/ground constraints after blending.
transitions.holdToDribble: Keep the target first upper-hand pose at phase0 while the two-hand hold transfers to one dribbling hand. Start the free-flight clock only when that transfer completes, so the first floor bounce remains visible and physical.
transitions.interrupt: Start from the currently displayed pose and measured ball velocity; no restart at the old source pose.
transitions.ballContinuityCheck: source/motion-checks.mjs: independent second-order finite differences at actual blend begin/end and interruptions.

limitations: Animation does not infer a gameplay outcome.
Palmar marker residual is not a continuous triangle/ball collision proof; the independent skin audit samples actual morphed vertices.
In-place running/walking require matching game translation; no locomotion world-foot lock is claimed in the stationary viewer.
Physical phone performance is separate from desktop browser measurements.
